tipp.mehlieren: Flour only right before frying, never let it sit – otherwise the flour draws moisture and the crust turns soggy instead of crisp.
tipp.zwiebel_schneiden: Leave the root end on while cutting; it holds the layers together – more even pieces, and easier on the eyes because less juice escapes.
tipp.koecheln_lassen: Gentle bubbles only, never a rolling boil – too much heat makes stock cloudy and meat tough instead of tender.
tipp.apfel_schaelen: Peel as thinly as you can; most of the aroma sits directly under the skin.
tipp.knoblauch_schaelen: Press the clove with the flat of the blade and the skin comes off by itself – faster, and easier on your fingers.
tipp.palatschinken_wenden: Turn only once the edge comes away from the pan and the surface looks matt – turned too early, the batter tears.
tipp.risotto_ruehren: Add stock a ladle at a time and only top up once the last one is absorbed – that releases the starch gently, and that is what makes it creamy.
tipp.ruehrteig_unterheben: Lift from the bottom up with a whisk or spatula, do not stir – otherwise the air you beat in disappears again.
tipp.schwarte_einschneiden: Score the rind only, not into the meat – otherwise the juices run out while roasting instead of the crackling puffing up.
tipp.teig_kneten: Knead firmly for at least 8–10 minutes, until it feels smooth and elastic – only then has enough gluten formed for the dough to rise.
tipp.eiweiss_schlagen: Bowl and whisk must be completely free of fat, or the egg white will not stiffen – even a trace of yolk is enough to stop it.
tipp.strudelteig_ausziehen: Pull from the middle outwards, with the back of your hand rather than your fingertips – it tears less often and gets evenly thin.
tipp.filetieren: Always cut against the bones, never with them – keep the knife flat and pull it through in one motion instead of sawing.
tipp.germteig_gehen_lassen: Cover it and let it rise somewhere warm and draught-free – above 40°C the yeast dies and the dough stays flat.
tipp.schnitzel_klopfen: Pound between two sheets of cling film, evenly from the middle outwards – it protects the fibres and keeps the meat from fraying.

tippAllgemein.1: Mise en place: everything for this step weighed out and within reach before you start – that is the difference between a calm kitchen and a hectic one.
tippAllgemein.2: Wipe the board and knife clean in between, especially after raw meat or fish – professionals keep the steps strictly apart.
tippAllgemein.3: Read the whole step once before you start – finding out mid-way what comes next costs you time and timing.
tippAllgemein.4: Always bring the pan or pot up to temperature before adding anything – started cold, many ingredients draw water instead of browning.
tippAllgemein.5: Cook with your nose: roasting aromas that smell bitter usually announce themselves a few seconds early – by then, turning the heat down is already too late.

tippAbschluss.1: Warm plates make a real difference when serving – a quick warm-up keeps the food hot for longer.
tippAbschluss.2: Add fresh herbs or garnish right at the very end – too early, and they lose their colour and aroma.
tippAbschluss.3: Leftovers cool down much faster in a shallow dish than in a deep pot – worth doing before they go in the fridge.

sonstiges.nasHinweis: Your NAS must be reachable from the internet – our server cannot reach a home-network address (192.168.…). On Synology, QNAP, TrueNAS and Nextcloud the setting is called "WebDAV".

sonstiges.nasAnleitungSynology: Control Panel → Package Center → install and open "WebDAV Server". Tick "Enable HTTPS", note port 5006. Remote access via QuickConnect or DDNS must be set up.
sonstiges.nasAnleitungQnap: Control Panel → Applications → Web Server → "WebDAV" tab. Switch it on and set the per-folder permissions. Remote access via myQNAPcloud.
sonstiges.nasAnleitungNextcloud: WebDAV is always on. The address is in the settings at the bottom left under "WebDAV" and ends with /remote.php/dav/files/YOURUSER.
sonstiges.nasAnleitungTruenas: Services → switch on WebDAV, set the protocol to HTTPS and assign a share.
sonstiges.nasAnleitungAndere: Look for "WebDAV" in your NAS settings and switch it on with HTTPS. Note the port and path.
sonstiges.nasWichtig: Your NAS must be reachable from the internet – our server is not in your home network and cannot reach an address like 192.168.1.50.
